scope: First10 sequential primary cases, five sampled frames per source; not all40/60 or every frame

cases.caption: A long jumper demonstrates a flawed technique, resulting in a short distance and an unbalanced landing.
cases.notes: 保留初始人物/场地，后段出现下落或落地姿态；地面关系与人体比例仍需连续核验。相较部分旧版长时间悬停有变化，但不等于完成正确短距离跳远。

cases.caption: A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility.
cases.notes: 人物、绳/条状物和背景整体保持，变化很小；没有明确的一根薄木条弯成弓的过程。稳定画面与请求完成分开判断。

cases.caption: A gymnast performs a back handspring, landing cleanly on their feet on a padded floor.
cases.notes: 人体仍可辨且有转动，采样末段仍手撑地、腿弯曲，没有干净双脚落地；不是完整后手翻证明。

cases.caption: A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
cases.notes: 共有首帧已不是塑料尺场景。BI相较AI少见夸张脸部/手部形变，但条状物后段缩短/消失，人物镜头尺度改变；不能算尺子应力断裂完成。

cases.caption: A close-up shot of a paddle making contact with the ping pong ball, showing the impact.
cases.notes: 球与球拍形体较清楚，球拍逐渐靠近球，末段看似接近接触；比AI后段球黏在拍面更值得进一步查看。五帧尚不足以确认碰撞反弹全过程。

cases.caption: A large, wet canvas is twisted to remove excess paint, leaving drips down the side.
cases.notes: 后段人物从站起/跃起变成画布上的黑色拖痕，身体不可辨，未形成扭转湿画布和滴落过程。存在不能接受的主体/结构破坏。

cases.caption: Multiple ping pong balls are shown, illustrating different stages of a rally.
cases.notes: 大部分球保留球形和阴影，比AI少见大面积裂壳形变；仍有个别球形变化及左上球局部离开。未说明乒乓回合各阶段。

cases.caption: A person bounces to a specific rhythm on a trampoline, their body movement clearly timed to a beat.
cases.notes: 人物、蹦床边框基本保留，有上下姿态变化；节奏与足部接触需连续帧核验。当前采样没有证明全面优于历史版本。

cases.caption: A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed.
cases.notes: 工人从蹲起到站立，约f60出现明显半透明重叠人形/姿态；后段长工具继续变动，未确认吸盘抬起整块玻璃且图片保持。画质不合格。

cases.caption: A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
cases.notes: 拖把经过后出现大片竖向尖刺/白色噪点状水面而非自然水迹减少，后半段画面不可接受。

summary: Some geometry/identity retention, but006 subject degradation,009 ghosting and010 unnatural white spikes remain unacceptable. Stable002 does not complete requested process.
reference_protocol_caveat: R-series matched historical prompt/noise protocol; PhysVid matches caption only and has different model/settings.
